000.prompt: Create a polished commercial-quality game-sprite candidate of a single early-1943 Tiger I heavy tank, designed as an original top-down orthographic RTS-style unit illustration. Use Image A and Image B as geometry/proportion references only: Image A is a front-view control reference, and Image B is a left-view control reference. Preserve the defining early Tiger I features: boxy near-vertical hull, rounded asymmetrical turret, prominent mantlet, long 88 mm gun, double-baffle muzzle brake, broad tracks, and interleaved rubber-rimmed road wheels. This is not a photo and not a raw 3D render; it should look like refined hand-painted game art suitable for a premium strategy game. Use a fixed orthographic / pseudo-isometric camera feel, with the tank centered at a consistent scale on a square canvas. Render the vehicle at vehicle yaw 0 degrees under a fixed camera at roughly 45 degrees azimuth and 35 degrees elevation, so the visible result is a front-right three-quarter orthographic view. Keep the tank isolated, with no scenery and no extra vehicles. Use a restrained sand-olive / dunkelgelb military palette, subtle weathering, an off-white turret number '131', and a small distinctive rust nick below the right turret hatch so this identity can stay consistent across later directions. Crisp silhouette, readable at small size, mature commercial finish, no logos, no watermark, no text other than the turret number.

No extra vehicles, no scenery, no watermark, no added text beyond the turret number.
